transcript.text: I don't know what Sorcery Mochabara is doing with the transit autopilot backpack because I've been able to fit all of this stuff. In this backpack it's ridiculous. The clamsher design opens super wide for easy packing and better visibility and they've even added two pockets here. My favorite part, the tech section. The laptop sleeve is elevated to inches from the base, you know what, drop your bag as much as you want your laptop is well protected. Another sleeve for an iPad, hell, I could even fit my second drone here and in the additional pocket for chargers, power banks etc. The bottle pocket is collapsible which is a nice detail, whether shoulder straps are 20 degrees at shape to follow the natural cover for shoulders. It's made with nylon and vegan leather, it looks good, it is really well-built and you know what I would easily be able to do a short trip with this as well. Nice to eat on Mochabara and cheers.
